serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I think this is it…
You: Hello?
Admin: Oh, hello there. How are you?
You: I’m fine, thanks…
Admin: It’s nice hearing from you. To be honest, I have been quite surprised that DAK actually recruited some useful people like you.
DAK?
Man who was calling me before said that he was in charge of recruiting. So that means that DAK is the nickname of the guy who was murdering people.
Admin: Don’t get me wrong, I appreciate everyone’s help, but we really needed someone with your expertise.
You: Y-yeah.
Admin: Is something wrong? You sound a little bit off.
You: No! Everything’s fine, I’m just nervous, that’s all.
Admin: Don’t be!
I need to act normal.
Admin: Well then, without further ado. Let’s get down to business, shall we?
You: Sure. 
Admin: I would like to ask you a few questions before we meet in person, if you don’t mind.
Questions?! That’s a big problem for me! I have no idea what Big Daddy even told that guy! I’m horrendously underprepared!
I need to avoid these questions at all cost
You: Questions? Do we really need to do this? Didn’t I prove myself already?
Admin: Oh, you sure did. I just want to be extra careful for both of our sakes. I’m sure you understand.
You: …
Damn it, I have no idea how to dissuade him from asking these questions without sounding super suspicious.
I guess I have no choice, but I doubt that this will end well…
Admin: How did you learn all of this?
Admin: I must say that you must be the most knowledgeable person about AI and other things I have met in years. I think the last time there was someone on your level was probably when Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism was still a thing and that says a lot.
You: Y’know, I learned stuff from the internet and uh… a lot just from playing around in my free time.
Admin: Oh really? I thought you said that you were in college?
You: Yeah, that too, but I dropped out.
Admin: Wait a minute, weren’t you on top of your class?
Shit…
You: Y-yeah, in the first year, but then I just lost interest and dropped out…
Admin: That’s quite peculiar, but then again, they say that most of the geniuses are quite eccentric.
Admin: What is your job right now?
My job…{{wi}} I need to keep my story consistent. Think! I dropped out so… It must be something depressing and low wage. 
You: I work at a convenience store.
Admin: Convenience store? That’s quite surprising, you said that you have a lot of experience in the IT field.
Fuck!
You: Of course I have! I’m a senior developer at a convenience store…{{wi}} chain’s HQ.
Uff…
Somehow I managed…{{wi}} but damn it wasn’t pretty…
Admin: That’s a nice position. You have a lot to lose by getting involved with us.
You: Y-yeah, I have like a car{{wi}} and a pool…
What am I even saying?! My voice is all shaky from stress…
Admin: Listen. I know you must be nervous because of all of this stuff, but don’t be. 
Admin: I took every precaution to ensure that our meeting will be safe. No one knows about its location or time beside you and me.
You: That’s good to hear…
Admin: I wouldn’t want you to get discouraged because of the risk. Quite frankly I need some help, but if you don’t feel ok with all of this, it’s fine if you give up on it.
You: N-no, I’m fine. Really…
Admin: That’s good to hear!
Admin: No offense, but your…{{wi}} aura was quite different through the net.
Admin: I imagined you as a person with a little more…{{wi}}  I don’t want it to sound rude, but…{{wi}} confidence?
What exactly did Big Daddy tell this guy?! Couldn’t he at least try to act more like me? Now I need to be wary of every word I speak…
You: Sorry if I disappointed you, but it is as you said, I feel much more confident behind the screen. I’m not really a people’s person.
Admin: IT people tend to be like this I guess. I can’t say I’m a social butterfly either, but it’s alright.
Admin: Sorry about all these questions. Everything checks out. I will send you the meeting place later.
You: Alright.
Admin: It was good talking with you and I hope we will progress for a better tomorrow for all, people and bots!
You: Sure…
Uff…
